items.heading: Mulgikapsad
details: Key ingredients: sauerkraut, pork, barley, onion
Simmer sauerkraut with chunks of pork in a large pot.
Add barley and onion for body and flavor.
Cook slowly for a long time until the pork is very tender.
Serve hot as a hearty one-pot meal.

items.heading: Kama
details: Key ingredients: roasted grain flour, buttermilk or kefir, sugar
Mix a blend of roasted barley, rye and pea flour (kama) with buttermilk.
Stir until smooth and slightly thickened.
Sweeten lightly with sugar or honey to taste.
Serve chilled as a traditional dessert or snack.
